title: Regulations Valencia Marathon 2026 — 46th Maratón Valencia Trinidad Alfonso Zurich
claims: S.D. Correcaminos, with institutional support from Valencia City Council and the OAM Municipal Sports Foundation, organises the 46th Valencia Marathon Trinidad Alfonso Zurich on Sunday 6 December 2026.

The race is an urban foot race of 42,195 metres on asphalt, approved by AIMS/RFEA, included on the RFEA and AIMS international calendars, and awarded a World Athletics Platinum Label; participants must be 18 or over on race day.
The start is at 08:15 and the race finishes by 15:15; the maximum official finishing time is 5:30 from the moment the runner passes the start line.

Any runner reaching km 25 after 12:57 on 6 December 2026 must hand in the bib, abandon the race and enter the sweeper car, under the projected 5:30 overall limit adjusted for the staggered wave starts.
Runners registering with the aim of finishing under 3:32:00 must prove a previous best in a marathon, half marathon, 15K or 10K within the last three years.

Maximum capacity is 36,000 bibs: bibs 1-10,000 cost €80; bibs 10,001-36,000 and ballot bibs cost €180; the waiting-list price is €200; a mandatory €5 day licence applies to runners without a current RFEA, FACV or Runner Plus Card licence.

Registration changes are free until 6 November; from 7 to 26 November a €25 administrative and bib-reprint fee applies; from 27 November no changes are allowed. A legal bib-holder change through the platform carries a €5 administration fee until 6 November.

The registration cannot be transferred to the following year. Injury withdrawal refunds 75% until 7 September, then 50% until 6 November, minus a €5 management cost; pregnancy withdrawal refunds 100% minus €5; optional refund insurance covers 80% for any reason until 29 November 2026 and can only be bought at registration.

Bibs and goodie bags are collected only at Expo 42K Feria Valencia, Av. de les Fires s/n, 46035 València: Thursday 17:00-21:00, Friday 09:00-21:00, Saturday 09:00-19:00; no pickup on race day; a third party may be authorised via the Runner's Area after 7 November.
Liquid refreshment is provided at approximately km 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 32, 35, 37.5 and 40, plus a final liquid and solid station at the finish.
A commemorative medal is awarded to all registered runners who finish within the established maximum time limit.
Sub-elite standards set on 2024-2026 approved courses: men under 30:00 for 10K/10,000m, 1:06:00 half marathon or 2:20:00 marathon; women under 35:30, 1:17:30 or 2:45:00.
Prize money for Spanish/FACV runners is paid below 2:20:00 men and 2:45:00 women, halved between 2:20:00-2:35:00 men and 2:45:00-2:55:00 women, and not paid above 2:35:00 men and 2:55:00 women.
Listed record bonuses: men's and women's course records 2:01:48 and 2:14:00 each carry €30,000; Spanish records 2:05:48 and 2:21:27 each €25,000; world record prizes are €1,000,000.
